name: Weapon Slave Array
description:
A weapon slave array is attached to a hardpoint and used to fire the weapon effectively from a remote station.  A crewmember taking the Attack Run, Dogfight, or Harass action and using a weapon equipped to this hardpoint is no longer limited to a forward facing arc.
Additionally, when taking the Fire action with a weapon equipped to this hardpoint, a crewmwmber at the helm no longer suffers disadvantage with a forward-facing limited arc.
